use_cases: Product showcase galleries on e-commerce sites with smooth hover transitions
Portfolio or creative work presentations with animated text effects
Hero sections for landing pages featuring media carousels
Team member or testimonial showcases with staggered animations

ai_summary: An animated slideshow component featuring hover-triggered slide transitions and text stagger effects powered by Framer Motion. The component provides smooth image transitions and animated text reveals, making it ideal for showcasing media content, portfolios, or product galleries with engaging interactive transitions.
